nodes.label: Case Detail Modal - Client Intake Brief (Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case detail modal dialog in the Captio legal case management application. The modal displays a case for 'Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.' classified as Business/Contract. The status pipeline shows stages: Invited, New, In review (currently active/highlighted), Consult scheduled, Conflict hold, Engaged, Declined, Closed. Action buttons include Edit, Client answers, Download HTML, and Delete. The main content area shows a 'Client Intake Brief' document with: Client name 'Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp. (EIN 45-2813047)', Case Classification 'Business / Contract — Vendor Non-Performance & Breach of Contract', Key Points including a Core Issue about ERP system vendor NovaSoft Systems LLC delivering defective software 15 days late with 12 unresolved critical bugs 5 months past deadline causing documented damages exceeding $400,000 USD ($240k canceled orders + $80k SLA penalties + $108k advance at risk), and Client Priority of contract rescission and recovery of $108,000 advance payment plus compensation for direct losses ($320k). The bottom section shows a Timeline with 'Demo client created' event at 6/4/2026, 2:44:05 PM and an input field for adding timeline entries.
design_decisions: horizontal status pipeline at top of case modal for quick status overview and navigation
active status highlighted with pill/badge style
separated action buttons into primary (Edit, Client answers) and destructive (Delete) groups
Client Intake Brief rendered as formatted document inside the modal
Key Points section uses bullet list with bold labels for scannable case summary
Timeline section at bottom tracks case activity history
Add timeline entry input field with inline Add button for quick notes
nodes.purpose: Case management detail view showing a specific client case with status tracking, intake brief document preview, and activity timeline for legal workflow management
nodes.case_type: Business / Contract - Vendor Non-Performance & Breach of Contract
